c128_attention_token_demand_upper_bounds.meaning: Sequence-row totals only; not an exact KV-memory requirement for this hybrid model.

server_cache_log_lines.line: (StageEngineCoreProc_stage0_replica0 pid=1660077) INFO 10-20 17:12:33 [kv_cache_utils.py:2327] GPU KV cache size: 326,716 tokens, Maximum concurrency for 8,192 tokens per request: 39.88x

interpretation_limits: Exact prompt row counts use the server's static estimator and are cross-checked against CPU build_prompt_frames.
Only local tokenizer files and code JSONL were read; no model or codec weight loading and no CUDA context initialization.
max_tokens=500 is the deployed stage-0 generation ceiling, not observed generation length.
Maximum concurrency log is computed from shared-pool blocks divided by the sum of required blocks across device KV groups at configured max_model_len; separate host pools may impose a smaller limit.
Logged KV token capacity is int(max_concurrency * max_model_len), an effective capacity, not necessarily a simple attention-token pool.
Hybrid Mamba state requirements and page rounding mean scaling logged concurrency by 8192/observed_length is not an exact capacity calculation.
Exact C128 capacity requires actual cache group specs, page sizes, pool block counts, Mamba cache mode and sequence requirements; startup lines alone are insufficient.
No C128 load test is performed here. max_num_seqs=128 is a scheduler limit, not proof of simultaneous resource sufficiency.
